findings_summary: 2 major + 3 minor amendments, no blockers. F-01 (major): A-track has no depends_on edge to A-public-fleet but its Features/Public endpoints reference PublicFeatureConfiguration.cs (owned by A-public-fleet) — conductor runs WIs sequentially in one tree via topo-sort with no stability guarantee, so A-track can be dispatched first and fail to compile; add depends_on:["A-public-fleet"] to A-track. F-02 (major): A-rating adds fields to the positional ~26-arg OrderDetailDto but lists only GetOrderEndpoint as caller; Accept/Arrive/Cancel/Complete/Start/CreateOrder also return it — make the new fields additive trailing-optional (int? RatingStars=null,...) or list all callers, else -warnaserror breaks. F-03 (minor): A-track must compare the HMAC with CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals (AC only says 'signature verifies'). F-04 (minor): tracking token exp=now+24h expires before scheduled (+7d) orders — derive exp from scheduledAt or scope scheduled-link validity to assignment 05 (latent; UC-004 E2E is ASAP-only). F-05 (minor): B-pwa must persist the fleet slug to authStorage before any logged-out/public call (client.ts auto-sends X-Fleet-Slug from authStorage; localhost has no subdomain).
verified_sound: Anonymous-request tenant scoping (TenantResolutionMiddleware gates only the JWT branch on IsAuthenticated; X-Fleet-Slug/subdomain branches run for anonymous requests; registered after UseAuthentication, before UseAuthorization; GetOrderByCode precedent; EF global query filter makes AllowAnonymous public/* fleet-safe; every public WI ships an A-vs-B isolation test). FleetHub is [Authorize] (two-mode tracking correct). Migration serialization: only A-public-fleet and A-rating add migrations and the A-rating->A-public-fleet depends_on edge is present; no other parallel-migration pair. ErrorCodes.cs three-writer concern is NOT a finding — conductor runs WIs sequentially in one working tree, sequential appends cannot conflict. Entity facts confirmed (Fleet has no color column; Tariff/Route/Order fields as claimed). { order } envelope / data.order.id correct. Pricing returns a range never a single estimate (CustomerOnly, server-side). geo/suggest widened to CustomerOrStaff, geo/route not. All 7 ACs mapped; deferrals (push-send->05, route-match->06, reverse-geocode->client stub) recorded.
disposition: Amendments folded into developer dispatch briefs: A-track gets F-01 (implement after A-public-fleet; depends_on edge) + F-03 (FixedTimeEquals) + F-04 (token exp vs scheduledAt); A-rating gets F-02 (additive trailing-optional OrderDetailDto params); B-pwa gets F-05 (persist slug before public calls). Lane A dispatched as a single backend-developer batch which sequences A-public-fleet before A-track and updates all OrderDetailDto callers in one pass, neutralizing F-01/F-02 structurally. Work-items doc not re-issued — this file + the briefs are the delta record. Roslyn structural pass N/A (cwm-roslyn-navigator MCP not configured).
